title: Analytics (Retired)
summary: Retirement record for the former local Analytics app and routes.
content_html:
Analytics (Retired)

The standalone Analytics application, source tree, runner, routes, APIs, configuration, checks, and tests are retired.

Current owners:

  • Studio owns canonical tags, tag services, and all five retained tag workflows.
  • Docs Viewer owns integrated document packages.
  • The public /analysis/ route remains a Docs Viewer scope and is unrelated to the retired application.

Do not recreate an Analytics shell, runner, compatibility route, proxy, source copy, or generic Data Sharing framework.

Durable Records

  • Analytics Overview records the final ownership outcome.
  • Analytics Roadmap records the completed retirement.
  • Tag Source Data routes to current Studio code and data.
